webui.settings.account.closure.title: Close account (soft delete)
webui.settings.account.closure.detail: Closing signs the account out everywhere and blocks future sign-in. The account data is archived, not physically deleted. Use the two-step confirmation to avoid accidental closure.
webui.settings.account.closure.confirmDe: Your account will be archived and all sessions revoked. This cannot be undone from this account.

webui.settings.about.title: About

webui.settings.about.intro.title: About this project
webui.settings.about.intro.body: Community Go is a modular Go backend with a React/Vite admin WebUI: platform shell, permission-aware business modules, IAM, organization directory, navigation policy and a settings center.
webui.settings.about.stack.title: Technology stack
webui.settings.about.repository.title: Source code
webui.settings.about.repository.body: The repository is published under the go-scaffold-template module path (github.com/rin721/go-scaffold-template). The exact public URL is documented in the repository README.
webui.settings.acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgements
webui.settings.acknowledgement.descripti: Credits for frameworks, dependencies and contributors.
webui.settings.acknowledgement.framework: Built with Go, React, Vite and Tailwind; UI components by HeroUI and react-aria-components (RAC).
webui.settings.acknowledgement.deps.body: Thanks to the open source ecosystem: lucide-react icons, the huma HTTP framework, gorm and the Go standard library.
webui.settings.acknowledgement.contribut: Thanks to every contributor and reviewer who helped shape this project.
